contract.parent_unit: A prebuilt, persisted EvidenceUnit over ordered source blocks, not a paragraph-only parent or a runtime reading-window expansion.
contract.prose: Combine contiguous content with the same page/version/source hash/heading and anchor. Block-count and character guards bound composition; they do not prove semantic completeness or hard-truncate source atoms.
contract.definitions: Keep each named definition together, without merging unrelated parameters. Preserve its entry context in retrieval children.
contract.lists: Combine a directly attached colon lead with the complete list. Preserve an unpaired list atom and mark that no lead was detected instead of inventing one.
contract.code: Preserve explicit usage containers containing instructions and alternative pre examples as one code unit, or a direct lead/pre pair. Otherwise retain the code atom and record the missing detected lead.
contract.tables: Retain table structure and explicitly associated footnotes. Do not claim arbitrary footnote inference or table retrieval projection.
contract.formulas: Retain connected equation, connector and adjacent variable-definition context as a formula unit, with retrieval explicitly deferred rather than dropping unsupported pieces to create an apparently complete text unit.
contract.provenance: Each emitted source block belongs to exactly one unit. The builder checks source order/identity, the complete supplied node inventory, XPath correspondence and member sequence. Persistent unit files are hash-bound and exclusive-create.
contract.children_and_delivery: Generate tokenizer-bounded children from each unit's validated projection; rank children, dedupe by prebuilt parent and restore the stored unit. No runtime neighbor stitching is used in the new pilot. The existing shared body-delivery budget still applies.

additional_fidelity_fix.finding: The earlier structural prototype treated unknown containers such as figure.usage as inline text. In the twelve-page source, 52 of 203 pre texts were not literal matches in any earlier block, including multiline examples; this count includes whitespace differences and is not claimed as 52 semantic failures.
additional_fidelity_fix.fix: Traverse containers containing block descendants instead of flattening them, while retaining inline MathML behavior. Recognize explicit usage containers during parent construction.
additional_fidelity_fix.sample_verification: All 203 nonempty source pre texts are preserved in a source-owning block after the fix: 201 as direct code blocks and two inside preserved structured XML. Checks compare parsed DOM code text with leading/trailing newline normalization, not original HTML bytes or executable behavior.
additional_fidelity_fix.history: The earlier 941-block registry and its pilot are retained unchanged. The corrected source registry has 1332 blocks from the same twelve pages because previously flattened structure is now represented explicitly.

corrected_small_pilot.checks: Membership, body reconstruction, persisted child/unit reopening and actual retrieval/expansion were checked.
corrected_small_pilot.results: Plane-strain definition plus thickness-stress statement, coupling comparison and the complete second-warning explanation remain delivered. First-warning selection, Tie permanence and the BC query remain unresolved. The same predeclared requirement probes have the same delivered/not-delivered outcomes as the preceding runtime-window pilot; no overall gain is claimed.
corrected_small_pilot.limits: This compares exposed questions on a small selected corpus. Parser representation, parent identities, candidate distribution and HNSW change; it is not a single-factor chunk-size A/B or held-out evaluation.

full_source_structural_dry_run.scope: Parsing, source membership, child length/coverage and code-text preservation only. These counts are a dry run: no full new index or embeddings were built, and passing does not prove mathematical, table, semantic or retrieval correctness.

remaining_boundaries: A structural unit is not automatically a complete engineering answer. Cross-section dependencies, unrecognized lead-ins or implicit qualifications can remain outside it.
Some code units still have no detected lead; footnote association covers only explicit structural markers.
Formula and table retrieval projections remain deferred. Two otherwise textual source blocks in the small corpus are withheld with unverified formula units; that is an explicit coverage tradeoff.
Lists/definitions may retain raw XML in the full evidence body. Faithful storage is not the same as an optimal human/Agent reading representation.
The exact API Catalog and its member-coverage gap are separate from this parent-unit pipeline.
Default product parser, full indices, Agent tools and model settings remain unchanged. These are tested retrieval components and a pilot, not a deployed Agent outcome improvement.
decision: Keep the small-child/full-parent route and the explicit unit-construction contract. This stage is complete enough to stop treating chunk strategy as an open-ended choice; next work should address full-index candidate validation and the remaining structured projections/selection failures, not repeatedly reinterpret token bounds as semantic quality. Do not switch the product default solely on structural checks.
